title: Meeting notes for your manager
situation: You took these raw notes in today's meeting with Green Leaf Gardening: homepage photos approved, blog moved to phase 2, booking form live by the 15th, Sam sends the hosting invoice, next check-in Thursday. Your manager wasn't there.
goal: Get the AI to turn the notes into a summary your manager can read in one minute.

role.placeholder: e.g. A project coordinator at a web agency

details.label: Who the AI should be
details.hint: Who should the AI be? For example, a project coordinator at a web agency.

details.label: Summarise the notes
details.hint: What should it do with the notes? Ask it to summarise them.

context.placeholder: e.g. Who will read it, then the notes themselves

details.label: The notes themselves
details.hint: The AI wasn't in the meeting. Paste the notes into the prompt.

details.label: Who will read it
details.hint: Who is it for? Say it's for your manager, who wasn't there.

format.placeholder: e.g. Bullet points: decisions first, then next steps

details.label: Decisions and next steps
details.hint: What structure? Ask for the decisions first, then the next steps with who does what.

details.label: Bullet points
details.hint: What shape? Bullet points are quick to read.

example.placeholder: e.g. A sample line in the style you want

details.label: An example to follow
details.hint: Bonus: show one sample line, like Booking form: live by the 15th.

details.label: A rule to respect
details.hint: Bonus: add a rule, like no more than 6 bullets.

conflicts.explain: Bullet points and a single paragraph at the same time? The roof cracks. Choose one shape.

answers.vague: The meeting covered several topics related to the project. Various items were discussed and some decisions were made. Follow-up actions will be taken.
answers.passable: Summary of the meeting: the homepage photos were approved, the blog was moved to a later phase, and the client wants the booking form soon. There are some follow-ups, including an invoice and another meeting.
answers.excellent:
Green Leaf Gardening: meeting recap

Decisions
- Homepage photos: approved
- Blog section: moved to phase 2

Next steps
- Booking form live by the 15th (our team)
- Hosting invoice: Sam sends it
- Next check-in: Thursday

ada.intro: Your manager missed the meeting. Build a prompt that turns your messy notes into a one-minute read.
ada.success: Solid! The AI knew the notes, the reader and the shape, so the summary is ready to send.
ada.takeaway: The AI only knows what you paste in. Give it the material, the reader and the shape.
